t: A tiny, low-cost Bluetooth chip from Texas Instruments for long-lived battery gadgets.
steps: Buy a TI LP-EM-CC2340R53 LaunchPad from a distributor such as DigiKey or LCSC.
Buy an LP-XDS110 debugger to go with it.
Install Code Composer Studio from TI.
Download the SimpleLink Low Power F3 SDK.
Import a basic Bluetooth example, such as a simple peripheral demo.
Flash it through the debugger and find the board in a phone Bluetooth scanner app.
Ask questions on the TI E2E Bluetooth forum.
meta: Open Board. From $42.06. A few stores.
